title: Book Two · Chapter 181: A Different Conversation
story:
Several weeks pass. The mornings grow cooler. Ronan carries his jacket until Mum tells him that jackets work better on shoulders.

At school, Jun has a drawing of River Street in his bag. He wants to show it to Mr Qiu after lessons. Ronan meets him at the gate.

“May I come?” Ronan asks.

“Yes. I need to go home after that.”

They walk together. Ronan wears his jacket now. Jun has the drawing under one arm, inside its stiff cover.

Mr Qiu looks at the page for a long time. He points to the table outside his doorway.

“You gave me a very straight table.”

“It is straight,” Jun says.

Mr Qiu presses one corner of the real table. It moves a little.

“Only when it feels like it.”

Jun laughs. He asks if he can add the private-book sign. Mr Qiu says yes. Ronan points to the little weight at its base, and Jun adds that too.

They leave the picture with Mr Qiu for an afternoon. Mr Qiu asks to keep it, and Jun agrees. Ronan watches him put it somewhere dry.

Outside, Jun stops near the corner.

“You showed Miss Wu the fourth practice,” he says.

“Yes.”

“That was the right thing.”

Ronan looks at him. He has wanted to hear that from Jun for weeks. He feels it now.

“I waited too long.”

Jun nods. A cart passes slowly between them and the far wall. They wait until it is gone.

“Does that change anything?” Ronan asks.

Jun looks down the road. “It changes that record.”

“I mean us.”

“I can walk with you. We can play. I am still not ready to make another booklet with you.”

Ronan feels hurt again. He wants to say he is different now. He has corrected the new record. But that cannot change the old booklets. Jun lost time because of them. He also had to help correct them.

“I hear you,” Ronan says.

Jun touches the empty cover under his arm. “I need that picture back tomorrow.”

“I can remind you at lunch.”

“All right.”

They reach the next turn. Jun goes toward his home. Ronan takes the road to the green door.

Inside, Mum asks if he is cold. He points to the jacket on his shoulders.

“It works,” he says.

“An excellent new idea.”

He helps her bring the work basket away from the window. After dinner, he writes a small reminder about Jun's picture in his own book. Then he turns to his school work. The reminder takes one line. He leaves it there until the next day.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

jacket＝夹克、外套；remind＝提醒；stiff＝硬挺的；ready＝准备好的。

## 理解问题

1. Jun认可了哪次行动，同时保留了什么边界？
2. Mr Qiu借放Jun图画的过程怎样体现明确同意？

## 读句子

**The reminder takes one line.**

拆开看：The reminder / takes / one line.

那条提醒／占了／一行。
